# Data Loading and Cleaning

```{r load-data}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

DATA_PATH <- "/root/.claude/uploads/7e325fe5-5704-55cc-9ede-a4a3bdde6097/4372d09e-Participation_Constructs.xlsx"

# Read raw data (first row is header)
raw <- read_excel(DATA_PATH, col_names = TRUE)

# Show original column names
cat("Original column names:\n")
print(colnames(raw))

# Rename columns to short working names
# Column positions (0-indexed in Python; 1-indexed in R):
# 1  = ID
# 2  = q22_raw   (Q22 Raw text)
# 3  = q22_bin   (Q22 Binary)
# 4..9 = info provision channel binaries
# 10..17 = consultation channel binaries
# 18 = q23_answered
# 19 = info_score
# 20 = consult_score
# 21 = q24       (Q24 Ordinal 0/1/2)
# 22 = q25       (Q25 Clean 1-5)
# 23 = flag
# 24 = notes

# Select and rename only the columns we need
df_raw <- raw %>%
  select(
    id           = 1,
    q22_raw      = 2,
    info_score   = 19,
    consult_score= 20,
    q24_num      = 21,
    q25_num      = 22,
    flag         = 23
  )

# Encode q22_raw as numeric: "Not informed at all"=0, "Informed only"=1, "Consulted"=2
df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    q22_raw_lower = tolower(trimws(as.character(q22_raw))),
    q22 = case_when(
      q22_raw_lower == "not informed at all" ~ 0L,
      q22_raw_lower == "informed only"       ~ 1L,
      q22_raw_lower == "consulted"           ~ 2L,
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

# Coerce numeric columns
df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    info_score    = as.numeric(info_score),
    consult_score = as.numeric(consult_score),
    q24_num       = as.numeric(q24_num),
    q25_num       = as.numeric(q25_num),
    flag          = as.numeric(flag)
  ) %>%
  mutate(flag = ifelse(is.na(flag), 0, flag))

# Remove inconsistent rows (flag == 1)
df_clean <- df_raw %>%
  filter(flag != 1) %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert q24 to ordered factor for ordinal models
    q24_ord = factor(q24_num, levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                     labels = c("None", "Informed", "Consulted"),
                     ordered = TRUE),
    # Convert q25 to ordered factor for ordinal models (keep numeric too)
    sat_ord = factor(q25_num, levels = 1:5, ordered = TRUE),
    # Integer version for some tests
    q24_int = as.integer(q24_num),
    q25_int = as.integer(q25_num)
  )

cat(sprintf("\nRows after removing flag==1: %d\n", nrow(df_clean)))
cat(sprintf("Rows with complete q25: %d\n",
            sum(!is.na(df_clean$q25_num))))
cat(sprintf("Fully complete rows (q22,info,consult,q24,q25): %d\n",
            sum(complete.cases(df_clean[, c("q22","info_score","consult_score","q24_num","q25_num")]))))

# Sub-datasets
df_sat  <- df_clean %>% filter(!is.na(q25_num))
df_full <- df_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(q22), !is.na(info_score), !is.na(consult_score),
         !is.na(q24_num), !is.na(q25_num))

cat("\nQ24 distribution:\n")
print(table(df_clean$q24_num, useNA = "always"))
cat("\nQ25 distribution:\n")
print(table(df_clean$q25_num, useNA = "always"))
```

# Helper: qtable Function

```{r qtable}
# Convenience wrapper: knitr::kable with caption and 3 decimal digits
qtable <- function(x, caption = "") {
  knitr::kable(x, caption = caption, digits = 3)
}
```

# Descriptive Statistics

```{r descriptive}
desc_vars <- c("q22", "info_score", "consult_score", "q24_num", "q25_num")

desc_stats <- lapply(desc_vars, function(v) {
  x <- na.omit(df_clean[[v]])
  data.frame(
    Variable = v,
    N        = length(x),
    Mean     = mean(x),
    Median   = median(x),
    SD       = sd(x),
    Min      = min(x),
    Max      = max(x),
    Skewness = e1071::skewness(x),
    Kurtosis = e1071::kurtosis(x),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

# e1071 may not be installed — fall back to moments package or manual
if (!requireNamespace("e1071", quietly = TRUE)) {
  skewness_manual <- function(x) {
    n  <- length(x); m <- mean(x); s <- sd(x)
    (sum((x - m)^3) / n) / s^3
  }
  kurtosis_manual <- function(x) {
    n  <- length(x); m <- mean(x); s <- sd(x)
    (sum((x - m)^4) / n) / s^4 - 3
  }
  desc_stats <- lapply(desc_vars, function(v) {
    x <- na.omit(df_clean[[v]])
    data.frame(
      Variable = v,
      N        = length(x),
      Mean     = mean(x),
      Median   = median(x),
      SD       = sd(x),
      Min      = min(x),
      Max      = max(x),
      Skewness = skewness_manual(x),
      Kurtosis = kurtosis_manual(x),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
}

desc_df <- do.call(rbind, desc_stats)
qtable(desc_df, caption = "Descriptive Statistics for Key Variables")
```

# Lavaan Path Analysis

```{r lavaan-path}
library(lavaan)

# Single-indicator path model: PST (satisfaction) ~ PL (participation level)
# With single indicators we fix residual variances to 0 (perfect measurement assumption)
# PL  = q24_num   (participation level, single observed indicator)
# PST = q25_num   (satisfaction, single observed indicator)

lav_model <- "
  # Measurement model (single indicators, residuals fixed to 0)
  PL  =~ 1*q24_num
  PST =~ 1*q25_num
  q24_num ~~ 0*q24_num
  q25_num ~~ 0*q25_num

  # Structural path
  PST ~ PL
"

lav_fit <- sem(
  lav_model,
  data       = df_full,
  estimator  = "MLR",   # robust ML
  missing    = "listwise"
)

summary(lav_fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
```

```{r lavaan-fit-indices}
fit_idx <- fitMeasures(lav_fit, c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr", "aic", "bic"))
qtable(data.frame(Index = names(fit_idx), Value = unname(fit_idx)),
       caption = "Lavaan Path Model Fit Indices")
```

# Ordinal Logistic Regression (polr)

```{r ordinal-logistic}
library(MASS)

# Model 1: satisfaction ~ q24 (numeric)
polr_mod1 <- polr(
  ordered(q25_int) ~ q24_num,
  data   = df_full,
  Hess   = TRUE,
  method = "logistic"
)
cat("Model 1 summary (ordered(satisfaction) ~ q24_num):\n")
print(summary(polr_mod1))

# Coefficients + confidence intervals
ci_mod1 <- confint(polr_mod1)
coef_df1 <- data.frame(
  Term   = rownames(coef(summary(polr_mod1))),
  Value  = coef(summary(polr_mod1))[, "Value"],
  SE     = coef(summary(polr_mod1))[, "Std. Error"],
  t_val  = coef(summary(polr_mod1))[, "t value"]
)
coef_df1$p_value <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(coef_df1$t_val))
qtable(coef_df1, caption = "Model 1: Ordinal Logistic Regression Coefficients")

# McFadden pseudo-R2
logLik_null <- logLik(polr(ordered(q25_int) ~ 1, data = df_full,
                            Hess = TRUE, method = "logistic"))
logLik_full <- logLik(polr_mod1)
pr2_1       <- 1 - as.numeric(logLik_full) / as.numeric(logLik_null)
cat(sprintf("\nMcFadden pseudo-R2 (Model 1): %.4f\n", pr2_1))
```

```{r ordinal-logistic-model2}
# Model 2: satisfaction ~ q22 + info_score + consult_score
polr_mod2 <- polr(
  ordered(q25_int) ~ q22 + info_score + consult_score,
  data   = df_full,
  Hess   = TRUE,
  method = "logistic"
)
cat("Model 2 summary (ordered(satisfaction) ~ q22 + info_score + consult_score):\n")
print(summary(polr_mod2))

coef_df2 <- data.frame(
  Term  = rownames(coef(summary(polr_mod2))),
  Value = coef(summary(polr_mod2))[, "Value"],
  SE    = coef(summary(polr_mod2))[, "Std. Error"],
  t_val = coef(summary(polr_mod2))[, "t value"]
)
coef_df2$p_value <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(coef_df2$t_val))
qtable(coef_df2, caption = "Model 2: Ordinal Logistic Regression Coefficients")

logLik_full2 <- logLik(polr_mod2)
pr2_2        <- 1 - as.numeric(logLik_full2) / as.numeric(logLik_null)
cat(sprintf("\nMcFadden pseudo-R2 (Model 2): %.4f\n", pr2_2))
```

# Ceiling Effect Diagnostics

```{r ceiling-effects}
q25_valid <- df_sat$q25_num[!is.na(df_sat$q25_num)]
q24_valid <- df_clean$q24_num[!is.na(df_clean$q24_num)]

# Proportions at ceiling / floor
ceil_5  <- mean(q25_valid == 5, na.rm = TRUE)
ceil_45 <- mean(q25_valid >= 4, na.rm = TRUE)
floor_0 <- mean(q24_valid == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
floor_01<- mean(q24_valid <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Q25 Ceiling (at 5):      %.3f\n", ceil_5))
cat(sprintf("Q25 Near ceiling (4+5):  %.3f\n", ceil_45))
cat(sprintf("Q24 Floor (at 0):        %.3f\n", floor_0))
cat(sprintf("Q24 Near floor (0+1):    %.3f\n", floor_01))
```

```{r ceiling-histogram, fig.cap="Q25 Satisfaction Distribution — Ceiling Effect"}
ggplot(df_sat, aes(x = q25_num)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 4.75, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Ceiling: %.1f%%", ceil_5 * 100),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 2, color = "red", size = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  labs(title = "Q25 Satisfaction Distribution",
       subtitle = "Dashed red line = ceiling (5)",
       x = "Satisfaction (1-5)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r ceiling-chisq}
# Chi-square test: observed vs uniform expected distribution across 1-5
obs_freq  <- table(factor(q25_valid, levels = 1:5))
expected  <- rep(length(q25_valid) / 5, 5)
chisq_res <- chisq.test(obs_freq, p = rep(1/5, 5))
cat("Chi-square test (Q25 vs uniform distribution):\n")
print(chisq_res)
qtable(data.frame(Category = 1:5, Observed = as.integer(obs_freq),
                  Expected = expected),
       caption = "Q25: Observed vs Uniform-Expected Frequencies")
```

# Jonckheere-Terpstra Test

```{r jonckheere}
# Use clinfun if available; otherwise manual implementation
jt_result <- tryCatch({
  if (requireNamespace("clinfun", quietly = TRUE)) {
    library(clinfun)
    jt <- jonckheere.test(
      x = df_sat$q25_num[!is.na(df_sat$q25_num) & !is.na(df_sat$q24_num)],
      g = as.integer(df_sat$q24_num[!is.na(df_sat$q25_num) & !is.na(df_sat$q24_num)]),
      alternative = "increasing"
    )
    list(J = jt$statistic, z = NA, p = jt$p.value, method = "clinfun::jonckheere.test")
  } else {
    stop("clinfun not available")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  # Manual Jonckheere-Terpstra implementation
  sub <- df_sat[!is.na(df_sat$q25_num) & !is.na(df_sat$q24_num), ]
  groups <- lapply(sort(unique(sub$q24_num)), function(g) sub$q25_num[sub$q24_num == g])
  k  <- length(groups)
  J  <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(k - 1)) {
    for (j in seq(i + 1, k)) {
      for (xi in groups[[i]]) {
        for (xj in groups[[j]]) {
          if      (xi < xj) J <- J + 1
          else if (xi == xj) J <- J + 0.5
        }
      }
    }
  }
  ns   <- sapply(groups, length)
  N    <- sum(ns)
  EJ   <- (N^2 - sum(ns^2)) / 4
  VarJ <- (N^2 * (2 * N + 3) - sum(ns^2 * (2 * ns + 3))) / 72
  z    <- (J - EJ) / sqrt(VarJ)
  p    <- 1 - pnorm(z)   # one-tailed
  list(J = J, z = z, p = p, method = "manual")
})

cat(sprintf("Jonckheere-Terpstra (%s):\n", jt_result$method))
cat(sprintf("  J = %.1f\n", jt_result$J))
if (!is.na(jt_result$z)) cat(sprintf("  z = %.3f\n", jt_result$z))
cat(sprintf("  p (one-tailed, increasing trend) = %.4f\n", jt_result$p))
```

```{r jt-visualization, fig.cap="Jonckheere-Terpstra Trend: Mean and Median Satisfaction by Q24 Group"}

ggplot(jt_summary, aes(x = q24_num)) +

    x        = "Q24 Participation Level",

    color    = ""
  ) +

  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Mediation Analysis: info_score -> q24 -> satisfaction

```{r mediation}
# Mediation: info_score (X) -> q24_num (M) -> q25_num (Y)
# Using manual Sobel test (Baron-Kenny steps) plus mediation package if available

# Step a: X -> M
mod_a <- lm(q24_num ~ info_score, data = df_full)
a_coef <- coef(mod_a)["info_score"]
a_se   <- summary(mod_a)$coefficients["info_score", "Std. Error"]

# Step b: M -> Y (controlling for X)
mod_b <- lm(q25_num ~ q24_num + info_score, data = df_full)
b_coef <- coef(mod_b)["q24_num"]
b_se   <- summary(mod_b)$coefficients["q24_num", "Std. Error"]

# Step c: X -> Y (total effect)
mod_c <- lm(q25_num ~ info_score, data = df_full)
c_coef <- coef(mod_c)["info_score"]

# Step c': X -> Y controlling for M (direct effect)
c_prime <- coef(mod_b)["info_score"]

# Sobel test statistic
ab       <- a_coef * b_coef
se_sobel <- sqrt(b_coef^2 * a_se^2 + a_coef^2 * b_se^2)
z_sobel  <- ab / se_sobel
p_sobel  <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_sobel)))

cat("Baron-Kenny Mediation Steps:\n")
cat(sprintf("  a  (info -> q24):              coef = %.3f, SE = %.3f\n", a_coef, a_se))
cat(sprintf("  b  (q24 -> sat | info):        coef = %.3f, SE = %.3f\n", b_coef, b_se))
cat(sprintf("  c  (info -> sat, total):       coef = %.3f\n", c_coef))
cat(sprintf("  c' (info -> sat | q24, direct):coef = %.3f\n", c_prime))
cat(sprintf("  ab (indirect effect):          %.3f\n", ab))
cat(sprintf("  Sobel z = %.3f, p = %.4f\n", z_sobel, p_sobel))

# Try mediation package for bootstrap CI
med_boot_result <- tryCatch({
  if (requireNamespace("mediation", quietly = TRUE)) {
    library(mediation)
    med_out <- mediate(mod_a, mod_b,
                       treat = "info_score",
                       mediator = "q24_num",
                       boot = TRUE, sims = 500,
                       boot.ci.type = "perc")
    list(
      ACME    = med_out$d0,
      ADE     = med_out$z0,
      Total   = med_out$tau.coef,
      PropMed = med_out$n0,
      ACME_CI = med_out$d0.ci,
      p_ACME  = med_out$d0.p
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}, error = function(e) NULL)

if (!is.null(med_boot_result)) {
  cat("\nBootstrap Mediation (mediation package, 500 sims):\n")
  cat(sprintf("  ACME (indirect): %.3f, 95%%CI [%.3f, %.3f], p = %.4f\n",
              med_boot_result$ACME,
              med_boot_result$ACME_CI[1],
              med_boot_result$ACME_CI[2],
              med_boot_result$p_ACME))
  cat(sprintf("  ADE (direct):    %.3f\n", med_boot_result$ADE))
  cat(sprintf("  Total effect:    %.3f\n", med_boot_result$Total))
  cat(sprintf("  Prop. mediated:  %.3f\n", med_boot_result$PropMed))
}

med_summary <- data.frame(
  Step          = c("a: info_score -> q24",
                    "b: q24 -> sat (|info)",
                    "c: info -> sat (total)",
                    "c': info -> sat (direct)",
                    "ab: indirect (Sobel)",
                    "Sobel z",
                    "Sobel p"),
  Value         = round(c(a_coef, b_coef, c_coef, c_prime,
                           ab, z_sobel, p_sobel), 4)
)
qtable(med_summary, caption = "Mediation Analysis: info_score -> q24 -> satisfaction")
```

# Path Diagram

```{r path-diagram, fig.cap="Path Diagram: Participation -> Satisfaction (DiagrammeR or ggplot2 fallback)"}
# Try DiagrammeR first; fall back to ggplot2 patch-based diagram
path_rendered <- tryCatch({
  if (requireNamespace("DiagrammeR", quietly = TRUE)) {
    library(DiagrammeR)
    grViz("
      digraph path_model {
        graph [layout = dot, rankdir = LR]
        node  [shape = rectangle, style = filled, fillcolor = '#AED6F1',
               fontname = 'Helvetica', fontsize = 12]

        Q22    [label = 'Q22\\nParticipation\\nLevel', fillcolor = '#D5E8D4']
        INFO   [label = 'Info Score\\n(Q23)', fillcolor = '#D5E8D4']
        CONSULT[label = 'Consult Score\\n(Q23)', fillcolor = '#D5E8D4']
        PART   [label = 'PARTICIPATION\\n(Latent)', fillcolor = '#FFE6CC']
        SAT    [label = 'SATISFACTION\\n(Latent)', fillcolor = '#DAE8FC']

        Q22     -> PART [label = 'w1']
        INFO    -> PART [label = 'w2']
        CONSULT -> PART [label = 'w3']
        PART    -> SAT  [label = 'beta']
      }
    ")
    TRUE
  } else {
    stop("DiagrammeR not available")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  # Fallback: ggplot2 path diagram using annotate + geom_segment
  box_df <- data.frame(
    x     = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 3.0, 5.5),
    y     = c(3.0, 2.0, 1.0, 2.0, 2.0),
    label = c("Q22\nPart.Level", "Info Score", "Consult Score",
              "PARTICIPATION\n(Latent)", "SATISFACTION\n(Latent)"),
    fill  = c("lightgreen","lightgreen","lightgreen","lightyellow","lightblue")
  )
  arrow_df <- data.frame(
    x    = c(1.1, 1.1, 1.1, 4.0),
    y    = c(3.0, 2.0, 1.0, 2.0),
    xend = c(2.4, 2.4, 2.4, 5.0),
    yend = c(2.3, 2.0, 1.7, 2.0),
    label= c("w1", "w2", "w3", "beta")
  )
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
                 aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
                 color = "navy", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(data = arrow_df,
              aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = (y + yend) / 2 + 0.1, label = label),
              color = "darkred", size = 3.5) +
    geom_label(data = box_df,
               aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, fill = fill),
               size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    xlim(-0.2, 7) + ylim(0.2, 3.8) +
    labs(title = "PLS-SEM Path Diagram",
         subtitle = "Formative indicators -> PARTICIPATION -> SATISFACTION") +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  print(p)
  FALSE
})
```

# Hypothesis Summary Table

```{r hypothesis-summary}
# Build a comprehensive hypothesis summary table
hyp_df <- data.frame(
  Hypothesis = c(
    "H1: Higher participation -> Higher satisfaction",
    "H2: Ordinal participation level (Q24) predicts satisfaction",
    "H3: Info score predicts satisfaction",
    "H4: Consult score predicts satisfaction",
    "H5: Significant monotone trend across Q24 groups (JT)",
    "H6: Ceiling effect present in Q25 satisfaction",
    "H7: info_score mediates q24 -> satisfaction path",
    "H8: Lavaan path PST ~ PL is significant"
  ),
  Test = c(
    "Spearman rho (q24 vs q25)",
    "polr ordered logistic Model 1",
    "polr ordered logistic Model 2 (info)",
    "polr ordered logistic Model 2 (consult)",
    "Jonckheere-Terpstra (one-tailed)",
    "Proportion at 5 vs chi-square",
    "Sobel z test / bootstrap ACME",
    "lavaan MLR path model"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Compute test results inline
spearman_q24_q25 <- cor.test(df_full$q24_num, df_full$q25_num, method = "spearman")

polr_coefs1 <- coef(summary(polr_mod1))
polr_p_q24  <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(polr_coefs1["q24_num", "t value"]))

polr_coefs2 <- coef(summary(polr_mod2))
polr_p_info <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(polr_coefs2["info_score", "t value"]))

# consult_score row may not exist if model failed
polr_p_cons <- tryCatch(
  2 * pnorm(-abs(polr_coefs2["consult_score", "t value"])),
  error = function(e) NA
)

lav_pars    <- parameterestimates(lav_fit)
lav_path_p  <- lav_pars$pvalue[lav_pars$lhs == "PST" & lav_pars$op == "~"]
lav_path_p  <- if (length(lav_path_p) > 0) lav_path_p[1] else NA

hyp_df$Result <- c(
  sprintf("rho=%.3f, p=%.4f", spearman_q24_q25$estimate, spearman_q24_q25$p.value),
  sprintf("b=%.3f, p=%.4f",   polr_coefs1["q24_num","Value"], polr_p_q24),
  sprintf("b=%.3f, p=%.4f",   polr_coefs2["info_score","Value"], polr_p_info),
  sprintf("b=%.3f, p=%.4f",   if (!is.na(polr_p_cons)) polr_coefs2["consult_score","Value"] else NA, polr_p_cons),
  sprintf("p=%.4f",           jt_result$p),
  sprintf("prop=%.3f, chi2-p=%.4f", ceil_5, chisq_res$p.value),
  sprintf("Sobel z=%.3f, p=%.4f", z_sobel, p_sobel),
  sprintf("p=%.4f", if (!is.na(lav_path_p)) lav_path_p else NA)
)

alpha <- 0.05
hyp_df$Supported <- sapply(hyp_df$Result, function(r) {
  p_match <- regmatches(r, gregexpr("p=([0-9.]+)", r))[[1]]
  if (length(p_match) == 0) return("Check")
  p_val <- as.numeric(sub("p=", "", p_match[length(p_match)]))
  if (is.na(p_val)) return("Check")
  if (p_val < alpha) "Yes (*)" else "No"
})

qtable(hyp_df, caption = "Hypothesis Summary Table (alpha = 0.05)")
```

# Boxplot: Satisfaction by Participation Group

```{r boxplot-sat-group, fig.cap="Satisfaction (Q25) by Participation Level (Q24)"}
df_box <- df_sat %>%
  filter(!is.na(q24_num), !is.na(q25_num)) %>%
  mutate(q24_label = factor(q24_num,
                            levels = 0:2,
                            labels = c("None (0)", "Informed (1)", "Consulted (2)")))

ggplot(df_box, aes(x = q24_label, y = q25_num, fill = q24_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.75, outlier.color = "red", outlier.size = 2) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.35, size = 1.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23,
               size = 4, fill = "white", color = "navy") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2ECC71", "#F39C12", "#9B59B6")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:5, limits = c(0.5, 5.8)) +
  labs(
    title  = "Satisfaction by Participation Level",
    subtitle = "Diamond = mean; red dots = outliers",
    x      = "Q24 Participation Level",
    y      = "Q25 Satisfaction (1-5)",
    fill   = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
